'''Magresh''' was one of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. Along with [[Sagresh]], Magresh caused huge variations in the tide on [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]].
